patch_description: The current program is confined to the D6-symmetric basin: every candidate passed to `polish` is either the exact D6 parametric optimum or a tiny jitter of it, so the soft-min/soft-max annealing can never discover asymmetric configurations that may beat the D6 family (the reference squared ratio 1/4.1658 corresponds to ratio ≈ 0.49, and the earlier general-seed program reached 0.24 squared ratio vs. 0.22 here). Two targeted changes: (1) add a short force-based repulsion relaxation (each point is pushed away from its nearest neighbor, followed by re-normalization) applied before the L-BFGS-B annealing — this spreads cramped seeds apart so the annealed soft objective starts from a well-conditioned configuration; (2) diversify Stage 4 by adding, besides the jittered D6 restarts, several random-on-sphere seeds and small D6-perturbation seeds with larger magnitude, each pre-conditioned by repulsion and then fully annealed/polished. All candidates still go through the existing hill-climb stages, so quality can only improve. The repulsion is cheap (vectorized, ~100 iterations) so the runtime stays well within timeout.
